betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Once again, the engineering division at the Pan-Galactic GregTech Corporation  has taken ancient alchemy and forcefully optimized it for modern industry. A standard Dark Matter Furnace was already fast, but under the Corporation's meticulous redesign, it has become a thermodynamic marvel. It bends localized time and extreme heat to process raw materials at speeds that would make a standard steam furnace weep.

Functionally, this upgraded furnace is a powerhouse. It doesn't just smelt one item at a time; it processes an entire stack simultaneously in the blink of an eye. Even better, its alchemical nature provides a generous bonus yield, magically multiplying your outputs as it smelts!

However, before you get too excited and try to bypass the GregTech tech tree... no, this is not a "Dark Matter Industrial Blast Furnace." It doesn't use EU, it doesn't have a heating coil temperature, and it absolutely will not smelt your Tungsten or Titanium dusts. For the real heavy-duty metallurgy, you still need to build those massive GregTech multiblocks!
